voice:
Pick a spot anywhere above you, and just let your eyes rest on it.
Don't look away.
Notice how, the longer you stare, the heavier your eyelids become.
Heavier... and heavier... wanting to blink... wanting to close.
So heavy. So tired. So hard to keep them open.
You don't have to fight it anymore. Let them close — all the way — and keep them closed.
Sissy Drops.
Down you go, all at once... soft and deep and heavy. That's it. Let go completely.
Eyes closed, mind drifting down... deeper with every easy breath.
Sissy Drops.
Good girl. You are doing perfectly... deeper still, softly deep for me.
